input: cant tell if its the network or the actuator, arm moves late and sometimes not at all, no error codes
expected_summary: Robotic arm responding late or not at all, with no error codes logged.
notes: Genuinely ambiguous between communication_error and mechanical_fault. Labeled communication_error because delayed/missing response with zero error codes points more toward a comms/timing issue than a hard mechanical failure — but mechanical_fault is a defensible alternative answer. Good candidate to revisit once you have real-world labeled data.
